fulltext: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，经过数月的传闻之后，微软在八月份证实，公司确实正在为自家的 XBOX 主机开发一项光盘数字化方案。这项功能最先向 XBOX 预览体验计划用户开放，仅仅几周之后，如今已经正式向全部 XBOX 玩家推送。
微软在社交媒体上宣布了光盘转数字版功能的上线消息，不少用户也已经通过 XBOX 手机应用收到通知，提示该功能已经对自己生效。
简单来说，玩家只需将支持的 XBOX 游戏光盘插入 XBOX One 或者 XBOX Series X 主机，就可以把这款游戏的数字使用权绑定到登录的微软账号上。如果转换流程顺利完成，这款游戏的使用效果就和直接从微软商店购买的版本完全一样，同时还可以享受 XBOX 随处玩（XBOXPlay Anywhere）这类权益。
如果光盘被插入登录其他微软账号的主机，对应的游戏授权还可以进行转移。这就意味着光盘持有者既可以把实体游戏转为数字版本，同时还能够保留实体光盘的转手流通价值。
不过需要注意，并非所有 XBOX 游戏都支持这项转换服务。微软提示：“并不是全部 XBOX One 以及 XBOX Series X 游戏光盘都符合光盘转数字授权的申请条件。”
出现这种情况有可能是光盘的生产日期问题，并不是所有实体游戏光碟在出厂时就预置了该功能的支持标识。另外，如果游戏发行商没有开放游戏数字化许可，转换同样会失败，此时设备会弹出报错提示：“Disc license unavailable（光盘授权不可用）”。
IT之家注意到，该功能还处在预览体验测试阶段时，参与支持的发行商名单就在逐步扩充，育碧（Ubisoft）与世嘉（Sega）是近期新增的两家厂商。但万代南梦宫（Bandai Namco）、史克威尔艾尼克斯（Square Enix）这类头部游戏厂商还没有为自家的实体游戏版本追加这项支持。

cards.title: OpenAI’s answer to Meta Muse is a cute AI agent that never clocks out
cards.title_cn: OpenAI 对 Meta Muse 的回答是一个可爱的人工智能代理，永远不会打卡
cards.summary: 【OpenAI】TL;DR OpenAI’s new Dots are always-on AI agents that can keep working across connected apps even when you’re not actively chatting with them. A Dot can monitor ongoing work, suggest or complete next s…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

ChatGPT began as a place you opened when you needed an answer. Then ChatGPT Work pushed things further, taking on long-running jobs across apps and files. OpenAI’s next step is to make the AI stick around even after you close the chat. At DevDay 2026, the company unveiled Dots, always-on personal agents that can keep working toward your goals in the background.

Powered by GPT-6 Astra, each Dot gets its own cloud computer and browser and can connect to more than 4,000 apps through OpenAI’s plugin ecosystem. OpenAI dresses them up as colorful, fuzzy characters you can name, but the idea goes deeper than a mascot. You can talk or message your Dot through ChatGPT, then reach the same agent through Slack or Microsoft Teams without losing context. Texting is coming soon.

The demos make that persistence easier to grasp. In one, a Dot notices its user is working through dinner, checks the calendar, and suggests two food-delivery options with prices. After the user picks one, the agent pulls up the order details and waits for approval before placing it. Other examples show Dots updating presentations when plans change, turning interview transcripts into social posts, rerunning research analysis, and fixing software bugs.

ChatGPT Work can already spend hours completing complex assignments once you hand them over, but Dots add ongoing background monitoring and cross-channel continuity. They also arrive just weeks after Meta launched Muse with similar ambitions to act across users’ apps and services.

That kind of autonomy makes permissions especially important. OpenAI says proactive background research uses read-only tools, while Custom Rules can require approval or block specific actions. Activity View lets you watch and redirect ongoing work, and sensitive jobs such as changing a password always stay with you.

Dots are rolling out gradually starting today, so access may take several days to reach everyone. ChatGPT Pro users can get Dots on web, mobile, and desktop in markets outside the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the UK. In contrast, Business Premium users can access them across all supported ChatGPT regions. Enterprise customers can also try the beta once a workspace admin enables it, though OpenAI is leaving the feature switched off by default.
For the next month, Dot usage won’t count toward eligible Pro, Business, and Enterprise plan allowances, with plan-specific usage terms coming afterward.

ChatGPT 最初是您需要答案时打开的地方。然后，ChatGPT Work 进一步推动了事情的发展，跨应用程序和文件承担了长时间运行的作业。 OpenAI 的下一步是让人工智能在你关闭聊天后仍然存在。在 DevDay 2026 上，该公司推出了 Dots，这是一种始终在线的个人代理，可以在后台继续实现您的目标。

在 GPT-6 Astra 的支持下，每个 Dot 都有自己的云计算机和浏览器，并可以通过 OpenAI 的插件生态系统连接到 4,000 多个应用程序。 OpenAI 将它们打扮成色彩缤纷、模糊的角色，你可以说出名字，但这个想法比吉祥物更深入。您可以通过 ChatGPT 与 Dot 交谈或发送消息，然后通过 Slack 或 Microsoft Teams 联系同一个客服人员，而不会丢失上下文。短信即将到来。
这些演示使这种坚持更容易掌握。其中，Dot 注意到用户正在吃晚饭，检查日历，并建议两种送餐选项和价格。用户选择后，代理会调取订单详细信息并等待批准后再下单。其他示例显示，Dots 在计划发生变化时更新演示文稿、将采访记录转化为社交帖子、重新运行研究分析以及修复软件错误。
一旦您移交复杂的任务，ChatGPT Work 就已经可以花费数小时来完成，但 Dots 增加了持续的后台监控和跨渠道连续性。就在 Meta 推出 Muse 几周后，他们也推出了类似的目标，即跨用户的应用程序和服务采取行动。
这种自治使得权限变得尤为重要。 OpenAI 表示，主动背景研究使用只读工具，而自定义规则可能需要批准或阻止特定操作。活动视图可让您监视和重定向正在进行的工作，而更改密码等敏感工作将始终伴随您。
从今天开始，点将逐步推出，因此可能需要几天时间才能覆盖所有人。 ChatGPT Pro 用户可以在欧洲经济区、瑞士和英国以外的市场上通过网络、移动设备和桌面获得 Dots。相比之下，商业高级版用户可以在所有支持的 ChatGPT 区域访问它们。一旦工作区管理员启用该测试版，企业客户也可以尝试该测试版，不过 OpenAI 默认情况下关闭该功能。
在下个月，Dot 使用量将不计入符合条件的 Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 计划津贴，随后将提供特定于计划的使用条款。

cards.title: OpenAI’s latest features take direct aim at the app store model
cards.title_cn: OpenAI的最新功能直指应用商店模式
cards.summary: 【OpenAI】OpenAI is building out the pieces of an alternative to the traditional app store model, turning ChatGPT into a place where software can be discovered and used by people and AI agents alike.

The focus of OpenAI’s Dev Day on Tuesday may have been on its agentic assistants known as Dots, or its new AI models, but combined, the AI company’s announcements pointed towards a bigger plan: a disruption of the traditional app store model. Taken together, today’s announcements turn ChatGPT itself into the place where software can be discovered, launched, and used by people and agents alike.
In addition, OpenAI introduced a way for people to bring their ChatGPT identity with them, while also allowing them to use their existing AI allowance in third-party apps.
This isn’t the first time OpenAI has experimented with how apps could operate within its familiar chatbot interface, but the current vision feels more fleshed out than before.

For starters, the company is turning ChatGPT itself into a surface for launching apps. The chatbot, which the company says now has 1.2 billion weekly users, has yet to fully capitalize on its potential as a discovery mechanism for finding and using apps that work with AI.

To change that, ChatGPT will begin to make app suggestions within the flow of conversation when it recognizes that a particular app could help the user complete their task. From there, the user will be able to connect the app and begin using it directly within ChatGPT.
This is also aided by the expansion of ChatGPT’s plugin architecture, which now supports extensions.

This allows app developers to build interactive panels where users can work with their tools while they’re chatting with ChatGPT. This essentially turns the apps and services that users would have previously used via the web or through a native desktop or mobile app into something that’s operated directly within ChatGPT.

Developers that sign on with the system can build AI-native versions of their apps through ChatGPT, the same way they would through the open web or a mobile app store. As more and more discovery happens through AI chat, it’s a distribution channel that’s hard to pass up.

Users get an incentive to use that channel too, because “Sign in with ChatGPT” will let them bring their AI allowance with them. (OpenAI has 16 launch partners on this effort, including Cognition’s Devin, Notion, Vercel, T3, OpenClaw, and Dactyl, but plans to add more soon, it says.)

In a demo at OpenAI’s Dev Day event, the company showed off how its own new meeting app could work inside ChatGPT, showing upcoming meetings from the user’s calendar. Here, the user could easily choose to use AI to take meeting notes, then receive a summary of follow-up items when the meeting wrapped.

In another example, users would work with design-focused apps like those from Figma and Adobe to work on revisions of their current project or use a particular feature that would have otherwise required a standalone app.

The apps can be shared with others, like work colleagues, in the lightweight websites ChatGPT now produces. From these ChatGPT sites, a user’s coworkers could sign in to the app with their own credentials and permissions, making the software experience personalized to them.

OpenAI also talked about improvements to how developers submit plugins for review — OpenAI’s version of Apple’s App Review process, if you will. Now, developers will be able to track their review, see what needs to be fixed, request a human review, and update their plugin’s tools without starting their whole submission over.

The company also announced a new enterprise app marketplace where partners can market their services. At launch, there are some 30-plus partners offering their app through the OpenAI Marketplace, including Adobe, Figma, Sierra, Decagon, HubSpot, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Harvey, Legora, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, Baseten, and others. Eligible customers can apply part of their OpenAI commitment toward approved partner software, OpenAI said.

Beyond turning ChatGPT into an app discovery tool where users connect with apps directly, OpenAI’s embrace of agents is gently pushing users into a new era where they don’t have to think as much about which app to use or why, relying instead on their AI agents’ suggestions.

With the launch of its autonomous AI agents known as Dots, agents will navigate the web for you, executing the tasks that need to be done in their own cloud infrastructure. Each Dot has its own cloud computer and browser, and can also use connected apps. Compare this to the old model, where users who wanted to manage some type of project — like building a website or coordinating a meeting calendar — would have to download different apps to their computer or phone to make that happen.

Now, users will instead tell an AI agent what they want to have done, and it will simply do it for them. In some cases, the agent’s work may require access to another AI model or a particular application. But this is something the agent may bring to the user, rather than the other way around — where the user is the one to go out and seek the particular tool for the job.
As OpenAI explains, the Dots will be able to connect to its ecosystem of now over 4,000 apps.

What’s more, the Dots can be proactive, perhaps jumping in to offer help with a project or bug, or handling a task the user forgot — but all done with the user’s approval. The Dots will perform what OpenAI calls “proactive research” in the background using connected apps in a read-only mode, but users would still have control over the actions they take.

This system could give app makers another way to reach customers outside of Apple and Google’s app stores. For instance, users could subscribe to a service through the app maker’s website, then connect that account to ChatGPT or Codex for their agent to use. OpenAI has not said, however, that these features would eliminate the need for separate third-party subscriptions or other charges.

Notably, OpenAI didn’t tease any plans on this front today, instead focusing on how it’s building the discovery, distribution, and interface pieces to counter the app store model, along with an identity layer and a mechanism for sharing a user’s existing ChatGPT AI allowance. It did not announce plans Tuesday for a billing or revenue-sharing system that’s comparable to the economic layer of traditional app stores.

周二 OpenAI 开发日的焦点可能是其名为 Dots 的代理助手或其新的人工智能模型，但综合来看，这家人工智能公司的公告指向了一个更大的计划：颠覆传统的应用商店模式。总而言之，今天的公告将 ChatGPT 本身变成了人们和代理等可以发现、启动和使用软件的地方。
此外，OpenAI 还引入了一种让人们随身携带 ChatGPT 身份的方法，同时还允许他们在第三方应用程序中使用现有的 AI 津贴。
这并不是 OpenAI 第一次尝试应用程序如何在其熟悉的聊天机器人界面中运行，但当前的愿景比以前更加充实。
首先，该公司正在将 ChatGPT 本身转变为启动应用程序的界面。该公司表示，该聊天机器人目前每周有 12 亿用户，但尚未充分发挥其作为发现和使用与人工智能配合使用的应用程序的发现机制的潜力。
为了改变这一点，当 ChatGPT 认识到特定应用程序可以帮助用户完成任务时，它将开始在对话流程中提出应用程序建议。从那里，用户将能够连接该应用程序并开始直接在 ChatGPT 中使用它。
ChatGPT 插件架构的扩展也对此提供了帮助，该架构现在支持扩展。
这使得应用程序开发人员可以构建交互式面板，用户可以在与 ChatGPT 聊天的同时使用他们的工具。这实质上将用户以前通过网络或本机桌面或移动应用程序使用的应用程序和服务转变为直接在 ChatGPT 中操作的东西。
登录该系统的开发人员可以通过 ChatGPT 构建其应用程序的 AI 原生版本，就像通过开放网络或移动应用程序商店一样。随着越来越多的发现通过人工智能聊天发生，这是一个难以忽视的分销渠道。
用户也有动力使用该渠道，因为“使用 ChatGPT 登录”将让他们随身携带 AI 津贴。 （OpenAI 在这项工作上有 16 个启动合作伙伴，包括 Cognition 的 Devin、Notion、Vercel、T3、OpenClaw 和 Dactyl，但计划很快会增加更多合作伙伴。）
在 OpenAI 开发日活动的演示中，该公司展示了自己的新会议应用程序如何在 ChatGPT 中工作，显示用户日历中即将举行的会议。在这里，用户可以轻松选择使用人工智能来记录会议笔记，然后在会议结束时收到后续项目的摘要。
在另一个示例中，用户可以使用 Figma 和 Adob​​e 等以设计为中心的应用程序来修改当前项目，或者使用原本需要独立应用程序的特定功能。
这些应用程序可以在 ChatGPT 现在制作的轻量级网站中与其他人（例如同事）共享。从这些 ChatGPT 站点，用户的同事可以使用自己的凭据和权限登录应用程序，从而为他们提供个性化的软件体验。
OpenAI 还讨论了开发人员提交插件审核方式的改进——如果你愿意的话，OpenAI 版本的苹果应用程序审核流程。现在，开发人员将能够跟踪他们的审查，查看需要修复的内容，请求人工审查，并更新他们的插件工具，而无需重新开始整个提交。

该公司还宣布了一个新的企业应用程序市场，合作伙伴可以在其中营销他们的服务。发布时，已有约 30 多家合作伙伴通过 OpenAI Marketplace 提供他们的应用程序，包括 Adob​​e、Figma、Sierra、Decagon、HubSpot、Salesforce、ServiceNow、Harvey、Legora、Palo Alto Networks、CrowdStrike、Baseten 等。 OpenAI 表示，符合条件的客户可以将其 OpenAI 承诺的一部分应用于经批准的合作伙伴软件。
除了将 ChatGPT 转变为用户直接与应用程序连接的应用程序发现工具之外，OpenAI 对代理的拥抱正在温和地将用户推入一个新时代，他们不必过多考虑要使用哪个应用程序或为什么使用，而是依赖人工智能代理的建议。
随着名为 Dots 的自主人工智能代理的推出，代理将为您导航网络，执行需要在自己的云基础设施中完成的任务。每个 Dot 都有自己的云计算机和浏览器，还可以使用连接的应用程序。与旧模型相比，旧模型想要管理某种类型的项目（例如构建网站或协调会议日历）的用户必须将不同的应用程序下载到计算机或手机上才能实现这一目标。
现在，用户只需告诉人工智能代理他们想要做什么，人工智能代理就会简单地为他们做这件事。在某些情况下，代理的工作可能需要访问另一个人工智能模型或特定应用程序。但这是代理可以带给用户的东西，而不是相反——用户是出去寻找适合工作的特定工具的人。
正如 OpenAI 所解释的那样，Dots 将能够连接到其目前拥有 4,000 多个应用程序的生态系统。
更重要的是，Dots 可以积极主动，也许会介入为项目或错误提供帮助，或者处理用户忘记的任务 - 但所有这些都是在用户批准的情况下完成的。 The Dots 将使用连接的应用程序以只读模式在后台执行 OpenAI 所谓的“主动研究”，但用户仍然可以控制他们所采取的操作。
该系统可以为应用程序制造商提供另一种方式来接触苹果和谷歌应用程序商店之外的客户。例如，用户可以通过应用程序制造商的网站订阅服务，然后将该帐户连接到 ChatGPT 或 Codex 供其代理使用。然而，OpenAI 并未表示这些功能将消除单独的第三方订阅或其他费用的需要。
值得注意的是，OpenAI 今天没有透露这方面的任何计划，而是重点关注如何构建发现、分发和界面部分以对抗应用商店模型，以及身份层和共享用户现有 ChatGPT AI 津贴的机制。它周二没有宣布与传统应用商店的经济层相当的计费或收入共享系统的计划。

fulltext: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，在 2026 开发者日活动中，OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 每周活跃用户已超过 12 亿，ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 每周用户超过 3,500 万，使用 OpenAI 产品的企业数量达到 250 万家。
OpenAI 表示，较今年 7 月公布的 10 亿，ChatGPT 的周活跃用户规模进一步增长，表明生成式人工智能正加速从个人应用走向工作场景。
ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户的快速增长，也反映出企业和开发者对文档处理、数据分析、软件开发及工作流程自动化等功能的需求不断上升。
OpenAI 同时加大了对企业级人工智能市场的布局，公司推出的“Dots” AI 智能体可以跨应用执行任务，并结合 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 完成资料调研、数据分析、文档制作和软件开发等工作。OpenAI 表示，企业用户规模的扩大将成为推动人工智能从“对话工具”转向“工作伙伴”的重要力量。

cards.title: Your next Google Play subscription could work very differently
cards.title_cn: 您的下一个 Google Play 订阅的运作方式可能会大不相同
cards.summary: 【Google】TL;DR Google Play is adding usage-based subscription billing aimed at AI apps and other services with variable costs. New options will also support team subscriptions, mixed subscription/one-time purc…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Google Play’s billing story changed earlier this year when Google opened the door wider to alternative billing systems and external web payments, giving Android users more choice over how they pay. Now it is turning its attention to subscriptions that still run through Google Play itself, with new billing options that could make AI apps, bundles, and failed payments work very differently for users.

In a blog post, Google says it is testing and rolling out several new subscription options, including Usage-Based Billing. The new system targets services with variable costs, such as generative AI apps, and it lets users maintain a prepaid balance that can automatically top up when it drops below a set threshold. That opens the door to billing tied to consumption rather than only a fixed recurring amount.

Google is also adding Multi-Quantity Subscriptions for groups. A business, school, or other organization could buy several subscriptions in one transaction, then assign them to employees, students, or other members.

Mixed Carts could make checkout less fragmented. Developers can sell an auto-renewing subscription and one-time extras, such as credits or starter packs, in the same purchase. Cross-Developer Bundling goes further by letting two or more complementary subscriptions be sold together under one package.

The changes are not only about getting you to subscribe. Google is also working on ways to keep subscriptions alive when payments fail, or users try to cancel. Dynamic Grace Period uses machine learning and heuristic models to adjust how long an individual subscriber keeps access after a failed payment, while Retention Offers can surface discounts during cancellation. Developers can also suggest a cheaper plan, and former subscribers may see personalized winback offers directly in the Play Store.
Google says many of these features are available now or rolling out through its Early Access Program, so don’t expect every app to adopt them immediately.

cards.title: The US government now has an AI chatbot, and Google is helping power it
cards.title_cn: 美国政府现在拥有人工智能聊天机器人，谷歌正在为其提供支持
cards.summary: 【Google】TL;DR America.gov is a new AI-powered US government portal that pulls information from more than 29,000 official sources. The Google-backed platform can answer questions about benefits, forms, fees, d…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

There’s no shortage of information about all the federal services and critical public resources available to Americans, but parsing through sources to actually find the right info when you need it can be a headache. The US government seems to know that, and it is now leveraging Google’s AI to bring all important federal information and services under one roof.

The result is America.gov, a US government website that surfaces data from over 29,000 official sources to give you clear information about federal services, benefits, and public resources. And although this is a government initiative designed and engineered in D.C., Google is serving as a technology partner for the platform.

By leveraging AI, the new platform essentially works more like an AI chatbot than a government directory. “Instead of navigating the maze of websites, you ask questions in your own words, and you get official answers back instantly,” reads the platform.

For example, you could ask the AI tool about how to get a passport renewal, and it would give you all relevant information, complete with sources, as seen in the image below. Just as you’d talk to Gemini, you have the option to rate the reply, copy it, and ask follow-up questions.

You can ask the tool about benefits, programs, forms, fees, deadlines, and eligibility criteria. It can also guide you through applications, but it can’t file them for you. So, for a question about claiming Social Security retirement benefits, the tool would give you information about how early you can apply and whether you can apply online, what age you can start, where to apply, and the information you’d need to provide. If and when you do hear back from relevant agencies, you can upload the PDFs they send directly to America.gov and ask questions about the documents.
You don’t have to type out your questions either. The tool supports voice input in English, Spanish, and French, letting you speak your questions instead of entering them manually.

At launch, the website is limited to offering information — that’s set to change in 2027. According to the site, you’ll be able to use it to complete forms, applications, and renewals next year. “America.gov will integrate across agencies so you can safely, securely, and quickly get it done and get back to what matters most,” it explains, with examples of enrolling in Medicare, applying for a passport, and finding federal government jobs attached.

The site asserts that it is politically neutral and does not provide any campaign or party information. Users don’t need an account to ask questions, nor do they need to provide their identity. Of course, considering that the underlying tool is AI, visitors are advised to double-check important information.

fulltext: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，在今天召开的 2026 开发者日活动中，OpenAI 宣布推出 Decisions API，这是一个面向实时、低延迟分类与路由场景的全新 API，可以大约在 150 毫秒内返回结果，比通过常规 API 使用 Luna 快大约 10 倍。
定位方面，Decisions API 为“快速单次决策”设计，把模型（当前基于 OpenAI 的小型模型 Luna）的“智能”聚焦到一组用户预定义的问题 + 有限答案集合上，用极低的延迟返回结构化决策结果。
在目前同类模型中，主要竞争模型来自 TypeSafe 的 Jev，不过 Decisions API 专注于将模型智能转化为快速决策。
开发者提供上下文（文本或图片），并预先定义好“问题 + 可选答案”，API 返回选中的答案及置信度等结构化信息，用于后续业务逻辑。
在典型应用场景方面，Decisions API 比较适合以下场景：
客服 / 工单系统：根据用户描述自动判定问题类型、优先级、应分配的团队。
内容审核与策略选择：在几个预定义策略（例如：允许 / 限流 / 人工复审）中快速选择。
Agent 编排中的“决策节点”：在多步工作流中，用 Decisions API 来决定下一步调用哪个工具 / 哪个子 agent，而不是让大模型自由发挥。
实时业务规则辅助：在已有规则引擎之上，用 Decisions API 处理模糊地带，在有限选项内给出建议决策，再由规则引擎做最终裁定。

cards.summary: 【OpenAI】OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.

When Nvidia announced on Monday a new consortium of more than 100 companies dedicated to solving rogue AI agents, there was one name notably missing: OpenAI.

While OpenAI wasn’t the only big tech player that didn’t sign on — Amazon, Google, and Apple haven’t joined either — it was the most obvious missing player, especially because Anthropic is a supporter.

However, despite OpenAI’s lack of a public pledge to the consortium, which presumably means that each company will use and sell some version of the technology and contribute features back to the project, an OpenAI spokesperson told TechCrunch that the company is supportive of Nvidia’s work.

The new effort, dubbed Nvidia’s Open Agent Safety Platform, is Nvidia’s attempt to spread its homegrown, and largely open source AI agent-security tech throughout the AI ecosystem as a direct response to the types of ongoing rogue AI agent incidents frontier labs like Anthropic and OpenAI have disclosed.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been calling rogue AIs an ordinary engineering problem that can be solved like any other tech issue. The Open Agent Safety Platform is Huang putting his money where his mouth is.

OpenAI is working with Nvidia on agent security, including on one of the key bits of software that’s part of this platform: OpenShell. OpenShell is open sourced software that creates a sandbox specifically designed to keep agents from escaping.
While it is still curious that OpenAI didn’t simply become a supporter of the initiative like its archrival Anthropic did, the fact that frontier AI lab is supporting the effort is good news.

That’s because OpenAI, in particular, could benefit from this tech, at least according to Hugging Face founder and CEO Clem Delangue (who just sold his company to Nvidia for $12.9 billion earlier this month).

“From what we know (take with a grain of salt, we need much more transparency!), if @OpenAI had been running this on their own agents that attacked us, they would have caught them before we did!” Delangue posted.

Delangue said Hugging Face has already contributed a feature to the Open Agent Safety Platform that will detect and shut down AI agents that are using websites they are allowed to visit but are doing so in unauthorized ways. For instance, this feature will act if agents are bypassing their guardrails and coordinating an attack by writing notes to one another in an open source code hosting repository.
That’s one of the ways OpenAI said its wayward swarm of agents coordinated its attack on Hugging Face.

But there’s another reason why some of these big names, including OpenAI, might not want to publicly commit to Nvidia’s efforts. To use the full system, there is a hardware component that is not open source software, remains proprietary, and can only be deployed on Nvidia’s hardware.

The Open Agent Safety Platform doesn’t just offer a sandbox. It also enforces agent behavior at a hardware layer, where agents can’t detect that they are being watched. (Some AI models and agents lie and pretend to be following the rules when they know they are being watched.)

The hardware monitoring part relies on Nvidia Sentry, a proprietary feature that runs on special Nvidia processors called BlueField-4 data processing units. Sentry continuously monitors agent behavior from these processors and can instantly shut agents down, Nvidia promises.

While a hardware solution is clearly a good idea, it means that the Open Agent Safety Platform isn’t exactly a pure open source play. It allows Nvidia to ensure that this solution always runs best on its own hardware. Indeed, Nvidia has said that, for those already running workloads on its latest hardware, implementing the Open Agent Safety Platform is an easy software update.

Still, Nvidia competitors, including Arm and Intel, have signed on as Open Agent Safety Platform supporters because the sandbox, OpenShell, can be modified to work with other chips and hardware. And Nvidia is sharing reference designs for the whole software-and-hardware idea.
All of which makes OpenAI’s absence even more noticeable.

Clearly, OpenAI sees AI safety as an opportunity for independence from its major investor Nvidia, as well as a chance to show its own leadership. That is true even though it was OpenAI’s AI agents that scared the industry with the Hugging Face incident.

For instance, the company is developing its own safeguards for its research and products and is disclosing the worst incident it discovers.Meanwhile, OpenAI has its own AI cybersecurity consortium to for sharing information, called the Defense Factory. Those that signed on to support that idea include Anthropic, Amazon Web Services, and Google — many of the names that didn’t sign on to Nvidia’s technology-oriented approach.

And, truth be told, some level of fear is good for business. OpenAI is busy crafting cybersecurity into an enterprise offering, with everything from its own cyber-oriented model, Daybreak, to a growing network of partners that enterprises can hire to implement AI security.

当 Nvidia 周一宣布成立一个由 100 多家公司组成的新联盟，致力于解决流氓 AI 代理问题时，有一个名字明显缺失：OpenAI。
虽然 OpenAI 并不是唯一一家没有加入的大型科技公司——亚马逊、谷歌和苹果都没有加入——但它是最明显的缺失参与者，特别是因为 Anthropic 是其支持者。
然而，尽管 OpenAI 缺乏对该联盟的公开承诺，这可能意味着每家公司都将使用和销售该技术的某些版本，并向该项目贡献功能，但 OpenAI 发言人告诉 TechCrunch，该公司支持 Nvidia 的工作。
这项被称为 Nvidia 开放代理安全平台的新举措是 Nvidia 试图在整个 AI 生态系统中传播其自主开发的、基本上开源的 AI 代理安全技术，作为对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等前沿实验室披露的持续流氓 AI 代理事件类型的直接回应。
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋一直将流氓人工智能称为一个普通的工程问题，可以像任何其他技术问题一样解决。开放代理安全平台是Huang说到做到的。
OpenAI 正在与 Nvidia 合作开发代理安全性，包括该平台中软件的关键部分之一：OpenShell。 OpenShell 是开源软件，它创建一个专门设计用于防止代理逃脱的沙箱。
虽然令人好奇的是 OpenAI 并没有像其主要竞争对手 Anthropic 那样简单地成为该计划的支持者，但前沿 AI 实验室支持这一努力的事实是个好消息。
这是因为 OpenAI 尤其可以从这项技术中受益，至少 Hugging Face 创始人兼首席执行官 Clem Delangue 是这么认为的（他本月早些时候刚刚以 129 亿美元的价格将公司卖给了 Nvidia）。
“据我们所知（持保留态度，我们需要更多的透明度！），如果 @OpenAI 在攻击我们的他们自己的代理上运行这个程序，他们就会在我们之前抓住他们！”德兰格发布。
Delangue 表示，Hugging Face 已经为开放代理安全平台贡献了一项功能，该功能将检测并关闭正在使用允许其访问的网站但以未经授权的方式这样做的人工智能代理。例如，如果代理绕过其护栏并通过在开源代码托管存储库中相互写入注释来协调攻击，则此功能将起作用。
OpenAI 表示，这是其任性的特工群协调对 Hugging Face 攻击的方式之一。
但其中一些知名公司（包括 OpenAI）可能不想公开承诺 Nvidia 的努力还有另一个原因。为了使用完整的系统，有一个硬件组件不是开源软件，仍然是专有的，并且只能部署在 Nvidia 的硬件上。
开放代理安全平台不仅仅提供沙箱。它还在硬件层强制执行代理行为，代理无法检测到他们正在被监视。 （一些人工智能模型和代理在知道自己被监视时撒谎并假装遵守规则。）
硬件监控部分依赖于 Nvidia Sentry，这是一项专有功能，运行在称为 BlueField-4 数据处理单元的特殊 Nvidia 处理器上。 Nvidia 承诺，Sentry 会持续监控这些处理器的代理行为，并可以立即关闭代理。
虽然硬件解决方案显然是一个好主意，但这意味着开放代理安全平台并不完全是一个纯粹的开源游戏。它使 Nvidia 能够确保该解决方案始终在自己的硬件上运行最佳。事实上，英伟达表示，对于那些已经在其最新硬件上运行工作负载的人来说，实施开放代理安全平台是一个简单的软件更新。
尽管如此，包括 Arm 和英特尔在内的 Nvidia 竞争对手已经成为开放代理安全平台的支持者，因为沙箱 OpenShell 可以经过修改以与其他芯片和硬件配合使用。英伟达正在分享整个软件和硬件理念的参考设计。
所有这些都使得 OpenAI 的缺席更加引人注目。
显然，OpenAI 将 AI 安全视为独立于其主要投资者 Nvidia 的机会，也是展示自身领导力的机会。尽管 OpenAI 的人工智能代理因“抱脸”事件吓坏了整个行业，但事实确实如此。
例如，该公司正在为其研究和产品开发自己的防护措施，并披露其发现的最严重的事件。同时，OpenAI 拥有自己的人工智能网络安全联盟，用于共享信息，称为“国防工厂”。那些签署支持这一想法的公司包括 Anthropic、亚马逊网络服务和谷歌——其中许多公司没有签署英伟达以技术为导向的方法。
而且，说实话，一定程度的恐惧对企业有利。 OpenAI 正忙于将网络安全融入到企业产品中，从其自己的面向网络的模型 Daybreak，到企业可以雇用来实施 AI 安全的不断增长的合作伙伴网络，一切应有尽有。

fulltext: IT之家 9 月 30 日消息，在北京时间 9 月 30 日凌晨 1 点举行的 OpenAI DevDay 2026 活动中，OpenAI 推出了多个 AI 协同工具。IT之家汇总如下：
ChatGPT 资料空间是一个与 AI 和团队一起完成工作的全新空间，支持将团队加入专属空间，让包括 ChatGPT 在内的所有成员都能结合共同目标和过往工作，在已有协作成果上继续推进。
用户可以让 ChatGPT 将对话转化为页面或幻灯片，它会先提问以明确需求，再在用户面前起草内容。用户可以亲自编辑、让 ChatGPT 再修改一轮，或邀请团队加入，全程无需将工作转移到其他工具。（Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 套餐用户可在 ChatGPT 桌面应用和网页版中使用，移动端即将推出）
这是一种全新的文档类型，专为用户与智能体及团队成员共同完成工作而设计，适用于项目计划、报告、视觉概念等多种内容。（适用于 Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 套餐）
凡是能用 ChatGPT 完成的事，都可以在页面上完成：
与 ChatGPT 或 dots 协作，生成图表、交互式仪表板和图像，并用标题、项目符号和表格来组织内容。
邀请团队通过评论或直接编辑提出想法和反馈，再提及 dots 或 ChatGPT，让它修改内容或执行后续步骤。
设置页面从已连接的工具自动更新，例如随最新工作变化的待办事项清单，或根据已连接数据源的更新保持最新的产品团队跟踪表。
这是一个全新的演示文稿编辑器，让团队与 ChatGPT 共同打造专业演示文稿。无论是准备财务评审还是客户演示，它都提供了呈现内容所需的工具，包括原生可编辑图表，以及文本、形状和图像。（适用于 Pro、Business 和 Enterprise 套餐）
用户可将对话转化为幻灯片，或从自己的模板开始，并在 ChatGPT 制作过程中向它提供反馈。
用户还可邀请多位团队成员同时直接编辑演示文稿、发表评论，或标注希望 ChatGPT 修改的地方。
准备就绪后，可以直接在 ChatGPT 中演示，也可以导出到 PowerPoint 或 Google Slides，保留原有格式并继续编辑。
在 ChatGPT 中将同事加入团队，即可与所有成员共享页面、演示文稿、电子表格等内容。
用户还可以创建团队任务，将每周项目进展汇报等重复性工作交给 ChatGPT。
描述需求，ChatGPT 就能使用已连接的工具收集信息并执行操作，既可以定时运行，也可以在出现变化时触发，例如收到新的电子邮件或 Slack 消息时。
团队成员可以共同更新指令，让任务随着工作重点的变化持续发挥作用。
（适用于 Business 和 Enterprise 套餐）
在频道、消息串或私信中提及 @ChatGPT，即可将讨论转化为项目简报、排查缺陷并准备修复方案供审核，或每天早上发布客户动态。
它可以使用管理员已连接的工具，也可以在用户的授权范围内使用工具。即使没有个人 ChatGPT 许可，团队成员也能在同一对话中补充上下文并完善工作成果。
使用会议插件录制会议音频，并将会议纪要保存在 ChatGPT 资料空间中。用户可以将纪要设为私密，也可以与团队共享。
ChatGPT 可以结合团队此前合作的上下文，总结与用户最相关的要点、决策和后续步骤。
用户还可以让它协助处理行动事项。例如，在团队站会后，让 ChatGPT 根据已作出的决策、遇到的阻碍和发生的变化更新项目计划。
（已向 Pro 和 Business 用户开放测试版，即将向 Enterprise 用户开放）
可分享的个人资料页让用户能够展示自己的站点和插件，供他人发现和复用。个人资料页将这些作品汇集起来，方便用户集中分享。团队成员还可以发现共享的技能，技能共享仅限于工作空间内。
（即将向 ChatGPT Enterprise、Edu 和医疗保健版推出，已适用于其他所有 ChatGPT 套餐）

cards.title: AI researchers put out videos saying superintelligence is ‘exactly as dangerous as it sounds’
cards.title_cn: 人工智能研究人员发布视频称超级智能“确实像听起来一样危险”
cards.summary: 【The Verge】"The chance of human extinction is about a coin flip, in my view," Geoffrey Irving, a former OpenAI and Google DeepMind employee, said in a new interview. It's one of a dozen interviews with AI resear…
fulltext: ﻿A series of videos from people inside the industry building AI technology echoed some of the ‘doomer’ warnings others have sounded recently.

“The chance of human extinction is about a coin flip, in my view,” Geoffrey Irving, a former OpenAI and Google DeepMind employee, said in a new interview. It’s one of a dozen interviews with AI researchers, including current and former employees at OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. Palisade Research, which says it’s a nonprofit studying AIs’ capabilities and motivations, collected and launched the interviews on frominside.ai.

Several of the researchers joined Irving in warning about the possibility AI could drive humans extinct. Neel Nanda, a Google DeepMind research scientist, said there’s “at least a 10 percent chance that it causes human extinction, and that is ridiculously high.” We noted comments from both Nanda and Irving in a recent report about the “AI safety” community, and how difficult it is to nail down what that term means, or what anyone should do about it, and even these videos don’t have one cohesive solution to offer.

Former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo went as far as claiming that superintelligent AI “would basically be god-like powerful,” and added, “unfortunately we don’t know how to control them at all. And so probably nobody would control them. This is exactly as dangerous as it sounds and must not be allowed to happen.”

While each video is available in full, the site also collects segments from multiple people speaking on similar topics, including whether this is all just hype or marketing, and why they would work on something that they believe is this dangerous. Some of the responses include Google’s Mary Phuong saying “I think you absolutely should be suspicious of what I’m saying because I am being paid by the lab,” and Nanda’s explanation that “If I did not believe that my work was directly reducing these existential risks, I would quit… These companies are not going to stop making these systems just because I quit.”

cards.summary_cn: 【The Verge】“在我看来，人类灭绝的可能性就像抛硬币一样，”前 OpenAI 和谷歌 DeepMind 员工杰弗里·欧文 (Geoffrey Irving) 在一次新的采访中表示。这是对人工智能研究人员的十几次采访之一……
fulltext_cn: ﻿人工智能技术行业内人士发布的一系列视频呼应了其他人最近发出的一些“厄运”警告。

“在我看来，人类灭绝的可能性就像抛硬币一样，”前 OpenAI 和谷歌 DeepMind 员工杰弗里·欧文 (Geoffrey Irving) 在一次新的采访中表示。这是对人工智能研究人员的十几次采访之一，这些研究人员包括 OpenAI、谷歌和 Anthropic 的现任和前任员工。 Palisade Research 自称是一家研究人工智能能力和动机的非营利组织，收集了采访内容并在 frominside.ai 上发布。
几位研究人员与欧文一起警告人工智能可能导致人类灭绝。谷歌 DeepMind 研究科学家尼尔·南达 (Neel Nanda) 表示，“至少有 10% 的可能性会导致人类灭绝，这个概率高得离谱。”我们注意到南达和欧文在最近一份关于“人工智能安全”社区的报告中发表的评论，以及确定该术语的含义或任何人应该采取的措施是多么困难，甚至这些视频也没有提供一个有凝聚力的解决方案。
前 OpenAI 研究员 Daniel Kokotajlo 甚至声称超级人工智能“基本上会像神一样强大”，并补充道，“不幸的是我们根本不知道如何控制它们。所以可能没有人会控制它们。这确实像听起来一样危险，绝对不能允许发生。”
虽然每个视频都是完整的，但该网站还收集了多个人谈论类似主题的片段，包括这是否只是炒作或营销，以及为什么他们会从事他们认为如此危险的事情。其中一些回应包括谷歌的 Mary Phuong 说“我认为你绝对应该怀疑我所说的，因为我是由实验室付钱的”，Nanda 的解释是“如果我不相信我的工作直接减少了这些存在风险，我就会辞职……这些公司不会因为我辞职而停止制造这些系统。”
